title: Volunteer 009: anterior and posterior arterial comparison
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Compare four Circle of Willis regions using the supplied MRA, categorical annotations and paired-side context.

scenes.title: Case 009 · Paired A1 courses
scenes.prompt: Follow the right and left A1 courses from the source internal carotid terminations toward the communicating region. Compare their displayed course and relative appearance in adjacent MRA sections.
scenes.note: Record the case, side, visible course, continuity across sections and supplied segment labels. Describe uncertainty where image signal and annotation coverage differ. Original healthy-volunteer source case 009. The source authors report physiological variation in this cohort; this view records an observation task rather than assigning a named configuration.

scenes.title: Case 009 · Anterior communicating region
scenes.prompt: Inspect the anterior communicating region with the paired anterior cerebral segments. Alternate the label overlay and original MRA to compare the supplied annotation with the visible image.
scenes.note: Record whether a communicating segment is labelled, how its course appears in the source image, and which observations would benefit from instructor review. Original healthy-volunteer source case 009. The source authors report physiological variation in this cohort; this view records an observation task rather than assigning a named configuration.

scenes.title: Case 009 · Posterior communicating regions
scenes.prompt: Compare the left and right posterior communicating regions with the internal carotid and posterior cerebral segments. Follow candidate continuity through adjacent original sections.
scenes.note: Describe the source side, image visibility and supplied posterior communicating labels separately. Use both sides and another volunteer as comparison contexts. Original healthy-volunteer source case 009. The source authors report physiological variation in this cohort; this view records an observation task rather than assigning a named configuration.

scenes.title: Case 009 · P1 and basilar configuration
scenes.prompt: Follow the basilar termination and the supplied right and left P1 segments toward the posterior cerebral courses. Compare their appearance from inferior and oblique views and in the original MRA.
scenes.note: Record the represented P1 segments, their visible relationships to the basilar artery and posterior communicating region, and unresolved continuity in the source image. Original healthy-volunteer source case 009. The source authors report physiological variation in this cohort; this view records an observation task rather than assigning a named configuration.
